I built a __13-page polished PDF itinerary__ for a 7-night Goa trip (15–22 Dec 2026, 2 adults from Bengaluru), saved at: __`C:\Users\kumar\projects\claudecodeprojects\mmt-acceptance-workspace\Goa_7Night_Itinerary_Dec2026.pdf`__
